notes.title: Two "THANK YOUs" and one invitation from 'A Wake Inn' team
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41045288/ebecaa8000bf32c1400556a464ae2ee5a7d8e4b7.png[/img]

[h1]What's up everyone?[/h1]

[h2]There's been a lot going on with '[i][b]A Wake Inn: Rebooked[/b][/i]' recently, so we're letting you know what exactly.[/h2]

[h3]First of all...[/h3]

A HUGE [b]THANK YOU[/b] (the first in this post!) to ALL OF YOU who visited our stand at [i][b]Poznań Game Arena 2021[/b][/i] two weeks ago! We were visited by CROWDS of people, and we wanted to chat and hang out a little bit with each of you.
We met mostly [b]gamers[/b], but also [b]journalists[/b], [b]influencers[/b], [b]developers[/b], [b]visual artists[/b], [b]hardware shop employees[/b] ([i]who trurly sympathise with all those who want to buy a GPU at a reasonable price now...[/i]), [b]students[/b], [b]moms and dads[/b], [b]linguists[/b], [b]authors[/b] and even... [b]cardiac surgeons*[/b]! Making long story short... WE. MET. YOU!!! And it was GREAT experience for the entire [i][b]'A Wake Inn'[/b][/i] team!
For every good word, hint, opinion - [b]we thank you[/b]! Because of that we can now create a game that you - the players - want to play.

[h3]Our second 'thank you' goes to...[/h3]

... the [b]DreadXP[/b] crew and all of those who watched their [b][i]Spooky Showcase[/i][/b], of which [b]we were a part[/b]! We are [b]very grateful that they included us in their livestream[/b].
If any of you haven't yet watched [b][i]Spooky Showcase 2021[/i][/b] you can do so here:
[previewyoutube=s3wl04A7ar4;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3]Last but not least![/h3]
[b]From 6th of November[/b] we will be participating in the [b]INDIE Live Expo[/b], to which you are [b]warmly invited[/b]! This festival is watched by [b]almost 28 million people[/b] and the broadcast will be in 3 languages - [b]Japanese, Chinese and English[/b].
Keep an eye out and remember to [b]watch the livestream[/b] on November 6 at 4:00 PM JST. Look out for 'A Wake Inn' there!
[previewyoutube=BiYqV3OKi00;full][/previewyoutube]

Remember to check out our [url=https://www.facebook.com/awakeinn][b]Facebook[/b][/url], [url=https://twitter.com/awakeinngame][b]Twitter[/b][/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/a_wake_inn/][b]Instagram[/b][/url], [i]Wakelings[/i]!



--
Stay healthy and [b]BOO[/b]! [i](well-we-are-late-a-little-bit-for-Halloween...)[/i]
[b]VR[/b]Bros



* And they are ALSO playing [b]VR games[/b]. Like... [b]for real[/b], LOL!

Stay healthy. Visit PGA 2021.

notes.title: Demo! Livestream!! Steam NEXT Fest is almost here!!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41045288/e7a81b616e356afa3edd5093f36d9185995b4e34.gif[/img]

[h1]'Hello' to every single one of you![/h1]

How are you? We hope everyting is just fine on the other side of the Internet! As promised about 3 weeks ago - we are getting back to you with a couple of [b]very[/b] exciting news! We were (and we still are!) working very hard to deliver you [b]the best possible experience of full immersion[/b] taken out from our VR version of the "A Wake Inn" [b]straight to your PC screen[/b].
But let's cut to the point, shall we...?

[h2]It's Steam NEXT Fest time...![/h2]
Yes. And we are taking a part in it! The NEXT Fest [b]starts on the 1st of October and will last until October 7, 2021[/b].
So what exactly does it mean [b]to you[/b]? Couple of things, so let's start with...:

[h2]Demo![/h2]
We are very excited to [b]finally[/b] share with all of you (and that's the part where you are getting all hyped up!) that our first public Demo version of "A Wake Inn: Rebooked" [b]will be at last live and ready to play/test/check out by everyone of you[/b]!
When the festival will start, simply go to our product page and download the demo version: [u][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1645700/A_Wake_Inn_Rebooked/]A Wake Inn: Rebooked Demo[/url][/u]

We really hope you will like it!
And [b]we would love to hear your feedback about our demo[/b]. To make it as convenient as possible for you - we created [b]special forum on our Community Hub[/b], where you will be able to post your opinions, thoughts and all of that what you are willing to share with us about the Demo.
You can find this [b]special, demo-dedicated forum[/b] here: [u][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1645700/discussions/0/]Steam NEXT Fest - Demo[/url][/u]

[h2]Livestream![/h2]
There is some more. On the 1st of October we will have [b]a special livestream of our Demo walkthrough, full-dev-commentary style[/b]! You will be able to watch how do we approach the gameplay, learn the features and mechanics of the standalone PC version of the game and - who knows - maybe you will discover something new...?

Make sure you follow our social media so you don't miss the start of the live stream!

We are leaving you - again: for now.
Please, enjoy the Steam NEXT Fest and have a great time with all of which we prepared for you!



--
Stay healthy... and (don't?) be scared
VRBros

notes.title: A Wake Inn: Rebooked - PC Announcement and the new trailer
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41045288/27277423b81b26bfeba3944584c19924f8934457.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Hello![/b][/h3]

After many months we can finally share that [b]A Wake Inn[/b] is coming to a [b]desktop PC[/b] as a standalone version called [b]A Wake Inn: Rebooked[/b]! That's why we are presenting you a brand new ([i]still hot![/i]) trailer of our game.

Feel free to check it out - and enjoy!

[previewyoutube=Lcd4NibiQzY;full][/previewyoutube]

Any thoughts or comments? Don't hesitate to share them with us in the comments or on our social media channels! 

[h3]Well, that is not all...[/h3]

We also took part in the GamesRadar's [b][i]Future Games Show 2021[/i][/b] which took place at the end of August. We presented new, never seen before fragments of gameplay from the [b]A Wake Inn: Rebooked[/b]. You have to see what we are preparing for all of you!

[previewyoutube=BJpw8a43jqs;full][/previewyoutube]

OK, that's all.
For now...

We will keep you updated with any future announcements: here and on our social media - so you better not close your eyes...


--
Take care (and stay healthy!)
VRBros
